answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital haven for agent networks by requiring bonded capital to participate in consensus. To validate a block, an agent must stake tokens, ensuring that each identity represents a financial knoll of resources rather than mere digital proliferation. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a falcon strike to their profitability, as spreading stake across infinite Sybils dilutes individual influence and imposes prohibitive capital costs without increasing total voting power.
